name: KCD:MP Feudal Wars
author: lol1luv@users.noreply.github.com
description: KCD:MP dedicated server running the Feudal Wars game mode (houses, wars, treasury, economy sinks).
startup: export DOTNET_ROOT=/mnt/server/dotnet; export PATH=$PATH:/mnt/server/dotnet; ./KcdMp.Server --config server.toml --gamemode gamemodes/feudalwars.lua

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -y
cd /mnt/server
# .NET 8 runtime (needed by KcdMp.Server)
if [ ! -d dotnet ]; then
  curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o dotnet-install.sh
  chmod +x dotnet-install.sh
  ./dotnet-install.sh --channel 8.0 --runtime dotnet --install-dir /mnt/server/dotnet
  rm dotnet-install.sh
fi
if [ ! -f server.toml ]; then cp server.toml.example server.toml; fi
mkdir -p data gamemodes
chmod +x KcdMp.Server 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT=/mnt/server/dotnet' >> /etc/environment.vnc 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'Installation finished. Upload KcdMp files or pull them from git.'

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: Map level: klaster, trosecko or kutnohorsko.
